## {.fragment-remove style="font-size: 125%;"}

### Why should we combine forecasts?

<canvas id="confetti-canvas" class="image-full"></canvas>

::: {.fragment .fade-out fragment-index=2 #better-accuracy-fragment-rm}
::: {.fragment .fade-in fragment-index=1 #better-accuracy-fragment}
::: {.center style="font-size: 3em; font-weight: 900; padding-top: 1em;"}

Better accuracy

:::
:::
:::

[:dart: **Better accuracy**: averaging reduces forecast error]{.fragment .fade-up fragment-index=2}  
[:shield: **More robust**: less sensitive single model failures]{.fragment .fade-up fragment-index=3}  
[:mag: **Interpretability**: explain forecasts by components]{.fragment .fade-up fragment-index=4}  
[:thinking: **Model uncertainty**: average over many models]{.fragment .fade-up fragment-index=5}  
[:bar_chart: **Coherent forecasts**: consistency across hierarchies]{.fragment .fade-up fragment-index=6}  


## {.fragment-remove}

::: {.center .r-fit-text style="font-weight: 900; padding-top: 0.5em;"}
How do we combine forecasts?
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-out fragment-index=2}
::: {.fragment .fade-up fragment-index=1 style="text-align: center; font-size: 1.5em; padding-top: 0.5em;"}

A simple average?

$$\hat{Y}_t = \frac{1}{n}\left(\hat{Y}_{1,t} + \hat{Y}_{2,t} + \cdots + \hat{Y}_{n,t}\right)$$
:::
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-up fragment-index=2 style="text-align: center; font-size: 1.5em; padding-top: 0.5em;"}

A weighted average?

$$\hat{Y}_t = w_1\hat{Y}_{1,t} + w_2\hat{Y}_{2,t} + \cdots + w_n\hat{Y}_{n,t}$$

where $\sum_{i=1}^{n} w_i = 1$.
:::

### Many types of combinations

Forecasts combinations appear in:

::: {.fragment .fade-up fragment-index=1}
::: {.callout}
## :jigsaw: Decomposition forecasting

Combine separate forecasts of **decomposed components**.
:::
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-up fragment-index=2}
::: {.callout}
## :abacus: Ensembles

Combine forecasts from **multiple models**.
:::
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-up fragment-index=3}
::: {.callout}
## :link: Reconciliation

Ensure forecast coherency across **related time series**.
:::
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-up fragment-index=4}
Today we'll cover the basics of probabilistic forecast combination for each type of combination model.
:::

:::
:::

## {}

::: columns
::: {.column width="40%"}
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}

### Probabilistic forecast combinations

::: {.callout-important}
## It's 2026 📅

Hopefully we've all moved on from point forecasting.

We need to combine forecasts *probabilistically*.
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-up fragment-index=2}
For this, we'll learn about:

::: {.fragment .fade-up fragment-index=2}
➕ **Convolutions**: sums of random variables
:::
::: {.fragment .fade-up fragment-index=3}
:cocktail: **Mixtures**: averaging distribution statistics
:::
::: {.fragment .fade-up fragment-index=4}
:chains: **Copulas**: joint distribution from marginals
:::
:::

:::
:::

![](../backgrounds/balint-mendlik-4-ORHffEh3I-unsplash.jpg){.image-left}


## {}

::: columns
::: {.column width="60%"}

### Software

Examples \& exercises focus on tidy R tools.

::: {.fragment .fade-up fragment-index=1}
::: {.callout}
## :package: R packages

* `fpp3`: tidy forecasting tools for R  
  Which bundles together:  
  * `tsibble`: temporal data structures
  * `feasts`: features \& decomposition models
  * `fable`: forecasting models
  * `fabletools`: combination tools
* `distributional`: probability distributions 
:::
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-up fragment-index=2}
Where possible, I'll also point to the equivalent tools in Python :snake:.

```{=html}
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/canvas-confetti@1.9.3/dist/confetti.browser.min.js"></script>
<script>
  (function() {
    var canvas = document.getElementById('confetti-canvas');
    var myConfetti = confetti.create(canvas, { resize: true, useWorker: true });

    var _defaults = {
      ticks: 72,
      decay: 0.94,
      startVelocity: 20,
      colors: ['FFE400', 'FFBD00', 'E89400', 'FFCA6C', 'FDFFB8']
    };

    var _active = false;

    function shootConfetti() {
      _active = true;
      var end = Date.now() + (15 * 1000);
      (function frame() {
        if (!_active) return;
        myConfetti({
          ..._defaults,
          particleCount: 2,
          angle: 60,
          spread: 55,
          scalar: 1.2,
          shapes: ['star'],
          origin: { x: 0 }
        });
        myConfetti({
          ..._defaults,
          particleCount: 2,
          angle: 120,
          spread: 55,
          scalar: 1.2,
          shapes: ['star'],
          origin: { x: 1 }
        });
        if (_active && Date.now() < end) {
          requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        }
      }());
    }

    function attachListener() {
      Reveal.on('fragmentshown', function(event) {
        if (!event.fragment) return;
        if (event.fragment.id === 'better-accuracy-fragment') {
          shootConfetti();
        }
        if (event.fragment.id === 'better-accuracy-fragment-rm') {
          _active = false;
          myConfetti.reset();
        }
      });
    }

    if (typeof Reveal !== 'undefined' && Reveal.isReady()) {
      attachListener();
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('load', attachListener);
    }
  }());
</script>
```
